blocking_findings.violation: security-practices.md CRITICAL section forbids silently normalizing or rewriting an identifier used for repository attribution without security-review sign-off; the OTLP event cwd field is now replaced by extractRepository(ctx.cwd) as a repository identifier, and git-workflow.md requires CRITICAL-change marking and sign-off for such changes
blocking_findings.why_blocking: the guide classes changes to attribution identifiers and their derivation as CRITICAL because they can misattribute analytics across repositories; no sign-off evidence exists in the commit or range
blocking_findings.remedy: record the security-review sign-off and CRITICAL callout in the PR, or emit the repository identifier in a separate field while leaving cwd unchanged
